newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Bertinotti urges broad talks on sell-offs.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Bertinotti urges broad talks on sell-offs.

text.p: Communist Refoundation leader Fausto Bertinotti said on Wednesday his party's opposition to a planned sell-off of Italian state telecoms company Stet should be addressed in a larger discussion of privatisations.
"As of today, I don't see a possibility of an agreement (on Stet)," Bertinotti told reporters at the Chamber of Deputies.
He added, however, "when you can't find an agreement on one point, you expand the playing field...If we know this is the case, let's consider the whole area of privatisations."
Refoundation, which guarantees the government's majority in the lower chamber of parliament, opposes full privatisation of Stet. It says 51 percent of the company should remain in public hands.
